author: Rob Loach
install_msg: Retro installed. Load it with `[p]load retro`, then attach a ROM to `[p]retro` and play. The emulator cores download themselves in the background.
name: Retro
short: Play retro console games in Discord
description: Play retro console games together in Discord. Start a game by name, URL, or an attached ROM or .zip (homebrew, or one you have the rights to) and control it with buttons under the screen. Eleven consoles are supported, from the Atari 2600 to the Super Nintendo, picked automatically from the file extension, each with its own controller layout. Every press posts an animated clip of the next few seconds. Games save automatically and pick up where they left off, even after the bot restarts: a save state restores the exact moment, and the cartridge's own battery save is kept beside it so an in-game save survives even an emulator core update. Cores download themselves, their own settings can be read and changed with [p]retroset coreoptions, and the bot owner can supply their own BIOS files for cores that need one. Emulated through libretro.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord channel and message ID of each game, the ID of the member who started it, the name of the game being played, and a copy of the ROM together with its emulator save state and the game's in-cartridge battery save, so a game can be resumed later. Nothing is shared with anyone. Cached ROMs, save states and battery saves are pruned automatically as a channel plays other games.
